plan.approach: Replace the RSA signing key and sign/verify calls with the ML-DSA-65 signature scheme from liboqs (oqs.Signature). Keys and signatures become raw byte strings instead of PEM/DER objects.
plan.interface_notes: Keep the enclosing function name, parameters and return type; only the key type and the bytes it returns change.
risks: ML-DSA keys and signatures are much larger than RSA-2048 ones.
Anything that stores or parses PEM/DER keys, or expects an RSA signature size, must change too.
